co2.applicability: Metabolic CO2 varies with age/activity and reference temperature/pressure. Here generation is an explicit cabin-volume scenario, not a railway legal limit or comfort approval.

coolaer.applicability: CRW035: 550 kg, 36.96 kW gross/20.9 kW net sensible and 15.272 kWe at 35 C outdoor/28 C return. Hotter output and complete interface scope remain unknown.

cpa.applicability: COM1 roof monobloc, 730 kg/36 kW; published exterior envelope ends at 45 C. No electrical-input curve or Baghdad acceptance.

glazing.applicability: Stationary plot supports rounded g=.82/.55 clear/IR-reflecting hypotheses. Windshield construction transferred to side/door glazing is unqualified; U=5.7 is a separate assumption.

insulation.applicability: H80 typical conductivity .031 W/m/K at 20 C; hot, bridged, joined railway panels require measurement. Core temperature and fire/structural limits are separate.

konvekta.applicability: Electric-compressor bus roof package, not an engine-driven evaporator-only comparison. 50 C performance limit does not establish nominal output there or railway qualification.

river.applicability: Stesalit-associated passenger-coach package: 24.6 kW thermal at 50 C; 16.5 kVA is apparent power, package mass and fresh-air rating are unspecified.

tk-lrc.applicability: Current manufacturer-page download; family ranges are not one correlated order specification. Reduced output at 50 C is unquantified.

tk-msu.applicability: Short-module tram equipment; reduced output only to 49 C. No published electrical-input curve.

underfloor.applicability: Manufacturer supports roof, underfloor and split architectures. No order-specific mass, capacity or 50 C map is supplied; no numerical mass saving is credited.
